name: San Lorenzo de El Escorial (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Lorenzo de El Escorial (a gridiron on white and a fleur-de-lis on blue).
history: The flag of San Lorenzo de El Escorial was approved on 1 October 1987 and is divided into three bands, red, silver and blue; the arms were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 26 February 1968, the gridiron alluding to Saint Lawrence.
